AllowedEmail.title: AllowedEmail
AllowedEmail.description: Allowlisted user account with role assignment for SignalGap access control.

role.description: Access tier: admin shares the master watchlist and manages access; member gets a personal watchlist.

addedBy.description: Email of the admin who granted access.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when allowlist entry was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when allowlist entry was last modified.

UserWatchlist.title: UserWatchlist
UserWatchlist.description: Saved custom category tickers, removed baseline symbols, and pinned favorites for either shared_admin or an individual member.

ownerId.description: Either 'shared_admin' for admins or the user's Firebase Auth UID.

scope.description: Whether this watchlist is the shared admin workspace or a member personal list.

customAssets.description: Custom instruments added to FX, Stocks, Crypto, or Commodities (max 60).

updatedBy.description: Email of the last user who updated this watchlist.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last update.

/allowed_emails/{emailId}.description: Allowlist of authorized emails keyed by lowercase email address.

/watchlists/{watchlistId}.description: Shared admin watchlist ('shared_admin') and per-member personal watchlists ('{uid}').
